The main takeaway from our work is that
OOD generalizability is not an intrinsic property of the data generating process but rather a property of the data distribution.
, in order to guarantee OOD generalizability, it is necessary to have a good control of the expansion function, which is a key ingredient of our theory.
OOD generalizability is not only determined by how invariant the learned features are, but also determined by the expansion function, which measures how much variance is amplified in OOD.
